en.s: The Battle of Volta Mantovana was fought on the 15th of October 1080 between troops raised by the schismatic bishops of Lombardy loyal to the emperor Henry IV and to anti-pope Guibert of Ravenna against forces commanded by Matilda of Tuscany. Margravine Matilda was defeated and the pro-Imperial forces gained the upper hand.

zh.s: 沃尔塔曼托瓦战役于1080年10月15日爆发，交战双方是效忠皇帝亨利四世和拉文纳对立教宗吉贝尔的伦巴第分裂派主教征召的部队，以及托斯卡纳的玛蒂尔达指挥的军队。玛蒂尔达女侯爵战败，亲帝国势力占了上风。

en.s: The Battle of Faḥṣ al-Jullāb was fought on Thursday 15 October 1165 between the invading Almohads and the king of Murcia, Ibn Mardanīsh. An Almohad army under sayyids Abū Ḥafṣ ʿUmar and Abū Saʿīd ʿUthmān, the brothers of the Caliph Abū Yaʿḳūb Yūsuf, went on the offensive against Ibn Mardanīsh in the summer of 1165.

zh.s: 法赫斯·朱拉卜战役于1165年10月15日（星期四）爆发，交战双方是入侵的穆瓦希德军队和穆尔西亚国王伊本·马尔达尼什。1165年夏季，哈里发阿布·雅各布·优素福的两位兄弟赛义德阿布·哈夫斯·欧麦尔和阿布·赛义德·奥斯曼率领穆瓦希德军队，对伊本·马尔达尼什发起攻势。

en.s: The Battle of the Rhyndacus was fought on 15 October 1211 between the forces of the Latin Empire and the Byzantine Greek Empire of Nicaea, established following the fragmentation of the Byzantine state after the Fourth Crusade. The Latin emperor, Henry of Flanders, desired to expand his territory in Asia Minor at the expense of the Nicaeans.

zh.s: 林达库斯河战役于1211年10月15日爆发，交战双方是拉丁帝国军队和拜占庭帝国解体后成立的尼西亚帝国军队。佛兰德斯的亨利皇帝希望以牺牲尼西亚帝国的利益为代价，扩大拉丁帝国在小亚细亚的领土。

en.s: The Battle of Valverde was fought on 15 October 1385, near Valverde de Mérida, Castile, between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Crown of Castile, and was part of the Portuguese Crisis of 1383–1385.

zh.s: 瓦尔维德战役于1385年10月15日在卡斯蒂利亚梅里达附近的瓦尔维德爆发，交战双方是葡萄牙王国和卡斯蒂利亚王权。这场战斗是1383—1385年葡萄牙王位危机的一部分。

en.s: The 1529 siege of Vienna was the first attempt by the Ottoman Empire to capture the city of Vienna in the Archduchy of Austria, part of the Holy Roman Empire. Suleiman the Magnificent, sultan of the Ottomans, attacked the city with over 100,000 men, while the defenders, led by Niklas Graf Salm, numbered no more than 21,000. Nevertheless, Vienna was able to survive the siege.

en.s: The Siege of IJsseloord or the Capture of Arnhem was a siege that took place between the 6 and 15 October 1585 at Arnhem (Gelderland in the Netherlands) during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). The Dutch and English were victorious when the sconce of IJsseloord after seven days capitulated and Arnhem fell into their hands. The English under Queen Elizabeth I had just signed the treaty of Nonsuch in August and as such the English contingent was enlarged and put under temporary command of John Norreys.

zh.s: 艾瑟尔奥尔德围城战又称阿纳姆攻占战，于1585年10月6日至15日在荷兰海尔德兰省阿纳姆进行，属于八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604）的一部分。荷兰和英国联军获胜，艾瑟尔奥尔德堡垒守军在围城七天后投降，阿纳姆也落入联军手中。英国伊丽莎白一世女王刚于8月签署《诺嫩苏赫条约》，因此英国派出的部队有所增加，并暂时交由约翰·诺里斯指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Thann (1638) was fought between the Weimar Army in the Service of the French, under Bernard of Saxe-Weimar and an Imperial-Lorraine under Charles de Lorraine. The battle was won by the Weimarans and the Imperials retreated back to the Franche-Comté, this was one of many attempts to relieve the besieged Breisach.

zh.s: 1638年坦恩之战的交战双方是为法国效力、由萨克森-魏玛的伯纳德率领的魏玛军队，以及由洛林的夏尔率领的帝国—洛林联军。魏玛军队获胜，帝国军队撤回弗朗什-孔泰。这是为解围被围困的布赖萨赫而发动的多次行动之一。

en.t: Parliamentarian forces win the Battle of Sherburn in Elmet
en.s: On October 15, 1645, Parliamentarian forces defeated Royalist troops at Sherburn in Elmet, Yorkshire, during the English Civil War.

zh.s: 1645年10月15日，英国内战期间，议会军在约克郡的谢尔本因埃尔米特击败保王军。

en.s: Zhu Yihai (Chinese: 朱以海; pinyin: Zhū Yǐhǎi; 1618–1662), courtesy name Juchuan (巨川), art name Hengshan (恆山) and Changshizi (常石子), was a regent of the Southern Ming dynasty from 1645 to 1653.

zh.s: 第21届釜山国际电影节于2016年10月6日至15日在釜山电影中心举行，由薛景求和韩孝周主持。本届电影节共放映来自69个国家的301部影片，包括96部世界首映和27部国际首映。电影节新设“新视野导演奖”，颁给韩国电影今日—新视野单元中制作能力最出色的两位独立电影新锐导演。

en.s: The siege of Stralsund was an armed engagement between the Electorate of Brandenburg and the Swedish Empire from 20 September to 15 October 1678, during the Scanian War. After two days of bombardment on 10 and 11 October, the severely devastated Swedish fortress of Stralsund surrendered to the Brandenburgers.

zh.t: 施特拉尔松德围城战（1678年）
zh.s: 施特拉尔松德围城战是勃兰登堡选侯国与瑞典帝国之间的一场武装冲突，于1678年9月20日至10月15日斯堪尼亚战争期间进行。10月10日至11日遭受两天炮击后，严重受损的瑞典要塞施特拉尔松德向勃兰登堡军队投降。

en.s: The Battle of Milazzo was fought on October 15, 1718 near the city of Milazzo in Sicily, Italy between Spain and Austria as part of the War of the Quadruple Alliance.

en.s: The Battle of Kloster Kampen (also known as the Battle of Kloster Kamp or Battle of Campen) was a French victory over an Anglo-German army during the Seven Years' War. The Allied forces were driven from the field.

zh.s: 克洛斯特坎彭之战又称克洛斯特坎普之战或坎彭之战，是七年战争期间法国对英德联军的一场胜利。盟军被逐出战场。

en.s: The Affair at Little Egg Harbor took place on October 15, 1778, in South Jersey during the American Revolutionary War. American Loyalists commanded by Patrick Ferguson surprised an outpost of Patriot Kazimierz Pułaski‘s Legion at night, killing 45 and capturing five. The raid took place about one week after the Battle of Chestnut Neck, a British raid aimed at suppressing privateers who used the area as a base to harass and seize British ships and their cargoes.

zh.s: 利特尔埃格港事件于1778年10月15日在新泽西州南部爆发，是美国独立战争期间的一次突袭。帕特里克·弗格森率领的美国效忠派夜间突袭卡奇米日·普瓦斯基军团的一处爱国派前哨，打死45人、俘虏5人。这次突袭发生在栗颈战役约一周后；英军在栗颈的突袭旨在打击利用当地为基地、袭扰并夺取英国船只及货物的私掠船。

en.s: The Battle of Raft Swamp was fought near Red Springs, North Carolina in Robeson County, on October 15, 1781 during the American War of Independence. Raft Swamp was well known for being a refuge for Loyalists during the American Revolution. On October 15, 1781, in the course of Gen. Griffith Rutherford's expedition against Wilmington, the Patriot cavalry vanguard commanded by Maj. Joseph Graham briefly engaged with some mounted Loyalists of Col. Hector "One-Eyed Hector" McNeill on Rockfish Creek. Major Graham's cavalry charged and broke the Loyalist cavalry and led to fierce combat on the narrow causeway, as well as another clash on a second causeway.

zh.s: 木筏沼泽战役于1781年10月15日在美国独立战争期间，在北卡罗来纳州罗伯森县红泉附近爆发。美国革命期间，木筏沼泽是效忠派的著名避难所。当天，格里菲斯·卢瑟福将军率军远征威尔明顿，爱国派骑兵先头部队由约瑟夫·格雷厄姆少校指挥，在罗克菲什溪短暂遭遇赫克托·“独眼赫克托”·麦克尼尔上校率领的效忠派骑兵。格雷厄姆少校的骑兵冲锋击溃了对方，随后双方在狭窄堤道及第二条堤道再次激战。

en.s: The siege of Anapa of 1788 was a major confrontation between the North Caucasians led by Sheikh Mansur and Turkish troops led by the commander of Anapa, Tatal-Bey, with a Russian force led by General Peter Tekeli. During the battle, the Russian army managed to force the Turks and North Caucasians into the fortress, after which they began besieging it. However, according to General Tekeli, the Russian army was not ready to storm Anapa yet, and if they managed to capture fortress, it would be difficult to hold. Thus, the Russian troops retreated from Anapa on October 15, 1788, and, except for minor skirmishes with Circassian mountaineers, the siege of Anapa was the last major battle of the campaign and the year 1788 as a whole.

zh.s: 1788年阿纳帕围城战是由曼苏尔酋长率领的北高加索军队、由阿纳帕指挥官塔塔尔-贝伊率领的土军，以及彼得·捷克利将军率领的俄军之间的一场大型战斗。战斗中，俄军迫使土军和北高加索军队退入要塞，随后开始围城。然而，捷克利将军认为俄军尚未准备好攻打阿纳帕；即便攻下要塞，也难以守住。俄军最终于1788年10月15日从阿纳帕撤退。除与切尔克斯山区居民发生的小规模冲突外，这场围城是该年度战役中的最后一场大型战斗。

zh.s: 拉特朗布莱战役于1793年10月15日在肖莱附近爆发，是旺代战争期间共和派对旺代军队取得的一场胜利。

en.t: Queen Marie Antoinette of France is tried and convicted of treason
en.s: Marie Antoinette (Marie Antoinette Josèphe Jeanne; 2 November 1755 – 16 October 1793) was Queen of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution. Born in November 1755 at the Hofburg in Vienna, Marie Antoinette was the fifteenth child and youngest daughter of Emperor Francis I and Empress Maria Theresa.

zh.t: 法国王后玛丽·安托瓦内特受审并被判叛国罪
zh.s: 玛丽·安托瓦内特（Marie Antoinette Josèphe Jeanne，1755年11月2日—1793年10月16日）是路易十六的妻子，1774年5月10日起担任法国王后，直至法国大革命期间君主制于1792年被废除。她于1755年11月出生在维也纳霍夫堡，是弗朗茨一世皇帝和玛丽亚·特蕾莎女皇的第十五个孩子，也是最小的女儿。

en.t: 1796 United States House of Representatives election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1796 United States House of Representatives election in Tennessee was held on October 15, 1796, to determine the first Congressman of Tennessee. Tennessee was admitted to the United States on June 1, 1796. Democratic-Republican candidate, Andrew Jackson defeated his Nonpartisan opponent, James Roby, with 98.9% of the vote. Andrew Jackson was seated in Congress on December 5, 1796.

zh.t: 1796年田纳西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 田纳西州于1796年10月15日举行美国众议院选举，选出田纳西州首位联邦众议员。田纳西州于同年6月1日加入美国。民主共和党候选人安德鲁·杰克逊以98.9%的选票击败无党派候选人詹姆斯·罗比。杰克逊于1796年12月5日就职。

en.s: The Battle of Fuengirola (October 15, 1810) was an engagement between a small Army of the Duchy of Warsaw garrison of a medieval Moorish fortress in Fuengirola against a much larger Anglo-Spanish expeditionary corps under Andrew Blayney. Blayney led an amphibious assault on Sohail Castle under heavy bombardment. The defenders, fighting with the First French Empire, were men from the 4th Regiment of the Duchy of Warsaw.

zh.s: 富恩希罗拉战役于1810年10月15日爆发，交战双方是由华沙公国军队驻守的富恩希罗拉一座中世纪摩尔人要塞，以及由安德鲁·布莱尼率领、规模大得多的英西远征军。布莱尼在猛烈炮火掩护下发起两栖进攻，目标是索海尔城堡。守军与法兰西第一帝国并肩作战，成员来自华沙公国第四团。

en.s: The Battle of Gawok took place on 15 October 1826 during the Java War between rebels under Prince Diponegoro and the Dutch colonial army. The battle took place near the village of Gawok, west of the city of Surakarta. Diponegoro's army, which had previously defeated Dutch columns on its march from Yogyakarta, intended to attack the Dutch military headquarters at Surakarta.

zh.s: 加沃克战役于1826年10月15日爪哇战争期间爆发，交战双方是迪波内戈罗亲王领导的叛军和荷兰殖民军。战斗发生在苏拉卡尔塔以西的加沃克村附近。迪波内戈罗的军队此前从日惹出发，沿途击败了荷兰军队纵队，随后计划袭击荷兰驻苏拉卡尔塔的军事总部。

en.s: The Battle of Glasgow was fought on October 15, 1864, in and near Glasgow, Missouri as part of Price's Missouri Expedition during the American Civil War. The battle resulted in the capture of needed weapons and improved Confederate morale, which had been dented after a defeat in the Battle of Pilot Knob. In late 1864, the Confederate leadership in the Trans-Mississippi Theater planned a campaign into the state of Missouri, in the hope of drawing Union troops from more important theaters east of the Mississippi River. Major General Sterling Price commanded the expedition, and initially hoped to capture St. Louis.

zh.t: 格拉斯哥战役（密苏里州）
zh.s: 格拉斯哥战役于1864年10月15日在密苏里州格拉斯哥及其附近爆发，是美国内战期间普赖斯密苏里远征的一部分。邦联军夺得所需武器，并在飞行员丘战役失利后重振了士气。1864年下半年，密西西比河以西战区的邦联军领导层计划进攻密苏里州，希望调走驻扎在密西西比河以东更重要战区的联邦军。斯特林·普赖斯少将率领此次远征，最初希望攻占圣路易斯。

en.s: The capture of Sedalia occurred during the American Civil War when a Confederate force captured the Union garrison of Sedalia, Missouri, on October 15, 1864. Confederate Major General Sterling Price, who was a former Governor of Missouri and had commanded the Missouri State Guard in the early days of the war, had launched an invasion into the state of Missouri on August 29.

zh.s: 攻占塞达利亚发生于美国内战期间。1864年10月15日，邦联军攻占了密苏里州塞达利亚的联邦驻军。曾任密苏里州州长、并在战争初期指挥密苏里州卫队的邦联少将斯特林·普赖斯于8月29日入侵密苏里州。

en.s: The Battle of Tres Castillos, October 14–15, 1880, in Chihuahua State, Mexico resulted in the death of the Chiricahua Apache chieftain Victorio and the death or capture of most of his followers. The battle ended Victorio's War, a 14-month long odyssey of fight and flight by the Apaches in southern New Mexico, western Texas, and Chihuahua.

zh.t: 特雷斯卡斯蒂略斯战役
zh.s: 特雷斯卡斯蒂略斯战役于1880年10月14日至15日在墨西哥奇瓦瓦州爆发。奇里卡瓦阿帕奇酋长维多里奥阵亡，大部分追随者也被杀或被俘。这场战役结束了维多里奥战争；在长达14个月的战争中，阿帕奇人在新墨西哥州南部、得克萨斯州西部和奇瓦瓦州各地辗转作战。

en.s: The Kép campaign (2 to 15 October 1884) was an important campaign in northern Vietnam during the opening months of the Sino-French War (August 1884–April 1885). A force of just under 3,000 French troops under the command of General François de Négrier defeated a major Chinese invasion of the Red River Delta launched by Pan Dingxin's Guangxi Army in successive engagements at Lâm (6 October), Kép (8 October) and Chũ (10 October and 11 October).

en.s: Preston North End 26–0 Hyde is the result of an FA Cup first round tie between Preston North End and Hyde of Manchester, which took place on 15 October 1887. It holds the largest margin of victory in an English football match at FA Cup or League level.

zh.t: 普雷斯顿北区26比0大胜海德
zh.s: 普雷斯顿北区以26比0击败曼彻斯特海德队，这是1887年10月15日举行的英格兰足总杯首轮比赛。该比分创下英格兰足总杯或联赛级别足球比赛的最大分差纪录。

en.t: Alfred Dreyfus is arrested on suspicion of treason
en.s: On October 15, 1894, French army captain Alfred Dreyfus was arrested in Paris on suspicion of treason. The case led to the Dreyfus affair, and he was later exonerated.

zh.t: 德雷福斯因涉嫌叛国被捕
zh.s: 1894年10月15日，法国陆军上尉阿尔弗雷德·德雷福斯在巴黎因涉嫌叛国被捕，由此引发德雷福斯事件。他后来获平反。

en.s: The Battle of Talisay in Batangas province, Philippines, was fought during the Philippine Revolution on October 12, 1896, that led to Filipino victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1896年10月12日，菲律宾革命期间，菲律宾八打雁省塔利赛爆发战斗，最终菲律宾方面获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Chile in 1910, following the death of President Pedro Montt on August 16 that year and the death of his successor, Vice President Elías Fernández Albano, less than a month later. Fernández's vice president Emiliano Figueroa called new presidential elections. Political parties agreed on presenting a single candidate – Ramón Barros – as a symbol of unity in celebration of Chile's first centenary of independence.

zh.s: 智利于1910年举行总统选举。当年8月16日总统佩德罗·蒙特去世，不到一个月后继任的副总统埃利亚斯·费尔南德斯·阿尔巴诺也去世。费尔南德斯的副总统埃米利亚诺·菲格罗亚随后召集举行新一届总统选举。各政党同意共同推举拉蒙·巴罗斯为唯一候选人，以此团结各方，庆祝智利独立百年。

en.s: General elections were held in Mexico on 1 and 15 October 1911.

zh.s: 墨西哥于1911年10月1日和15日举行大选。

en.s: The Rovno offensive — the operation of the Austro-Hungarian Northern armies against the armies of the Russian Southwestern Front — the so-called campaign on Rovno, or Lutsk-Rovno offensive operation. The purpose of the offensive was the liberation of Eastern Galicia, but by the end of the operation, a small part of Eastern Galicia was still held by the Russian Imperial Army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 罗夫诺攻势是奥匈帝国北方集团军群对俄国西南方面军发动的作战行动，也称罗夫诺战役或卢茨克—罗夫诺攻势。其目标是解放东加利西亚，但战役结束时，俄国帝国军队仍控制着东加利西亚的一小部分地区。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的攻势结束日期。

en.s: The Action of 15 October 1917 was a naval engagement of World War I between Imperial Germany and the United States off the coast of Mind Head, Ireland.

zh.s: 1917年10月15日海战是第一次世界大战期间德国帝国海军与美国海军在爱尔兰明德角海岸附近发生的一场海战。

en.t: Mata Hari is executed at Vincennes
en.s: On October 15, 1917, Mata Hari was executed by a French firing squad at Vincennes after a military court convicted her of espionage.
en.n: The statement records her conviction and execution, without treating disputed spying allegations as settled facts.

zh.t: 玛塔·哈丽在万塞讷被处决
zh.s: 1917年10月15日，玛塔·哈丽在万塞讷被法国行刑队枪决，此前军事法庭判她犯有间谍罪。
zh.n: 此处记录判决和处决，不将有争议的间谍指控写成定论。

en.t: J. R. D. Tata flies the Karachi–Bombay airmail route
en.s: On October 15, 1932, J. R. D. Tata flew a Puss Moth aircraft carrying mail from Karachi to Bombay via Ahmedabad. The flight marked the start of Tata’s airline service, the forerunner of Air India.
en.n: Karachi is in present-day Pakistan; Ahmedabad and Bombay, now Mumbai, are in India.

zh.t: 塔塔执飞卡拉奇至孟买航空邮运航线
zh.s: 1932年10月15日，J. R. D. 塔塔驾驶“狐蛾”飞机，从卡拉奇经艾哈迈达巴德飞往孟买，运送邮件。这次飞行开启了塔塔的航空业务，后来发展为印度航空。
zh.n: 卡拉奇今属巴基斯坦，艾哈迈达巴德和孟买今属印度。

en.t: Lluís Companys is executed in Barcelona
en.s: On October 15, 1940, Francoist authorities executed Catalan president Lluís Companys at Montjuïc Castle in Barcelona.

zh.t: 孔帕尼斯在巴塞罗那被处决
zh.s: 1940年10月15日，佛朗哥当局在巴塞罗那的蒙锥克城堡处决了加泰罗尼亚主席路易斯·孔帕尼斯。

en.s: The Defence of Przebraże (Polish: Obrona Przebraża, Ukrainian: Оборона Пшебража; 4 July — 15 October 1943) was fought between the Ukrainian Insurgent Army against the Polish Self–Defense, Home Army and Soviet partisans in the Łuck County of the Wołyń Voivodeship. The Northern Operational Group under the command of Dmytro Klyachkivsky and 3rd Operational Group "Turiv" under the command of Yuriy Stelmaschuk tried four times to destroy and conquer the largest Polish Self–Defense base and center in the Volhynia, but the UPA didn't succeed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 普热布拉日防御战（波兰语：Obrona Przebraża；乌克兰语：Оборона Пшебража）于1943年7月4日至10月15日爆发，交战双方是乌克兰起义军与波兰自卫队、波兰家乡军和苏联游击队。战斗发生于沃里尼亚省卢茨克县。德米特罗·克利亚奇基夫斯基指挥的北方作战群和尤里·斯特尔马舒克指挥的第三作战群“图里夫”曾四次试图摧毁并攻占沃里尼亚最大的波兰自卫基地，但均未成功。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列事件结束日期。

en.s: On October 15, 1944, Hungary’s regent Miklós Horthy broadcast an armistice proclamation in an unsuccessful attempt to take Hungary out of the Second World War.

zh.t: 霍尔蒂发表停战广播声明
zh.s: 1944年10月15日，匈牙利摄政霍尔蒂·米克洛什通过广播发表停战声明，试图使匈牙利退出第二次世界大战，但这一尝试最终失败。

en.s: Operation Hurricane was a 24-hour bombing operation to "demonstrate to the enemy in Germany generally the overwhelming superiority of the Allied Air Forces in this theatre" (in the directive to Harris ACO RAF Bomber Command) and "cause mass panic and disorginazation [sic] in the Ruhr, disrupt frontline communications and demonstrate the futility of resistance" (in the words of the Official RAF History).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 飓风行动是一场持续24小时的轰炸行动。英国轰炸机司令部的指令称，行动旨在“向德国敌人展示盟军空军在这一战场上的压倒性优势”。英国皇家空军官方史料则称，行动目标是“在鲁尔区制造大规模恐慌和混乱，扰乱前线通信，并表明抵抗毫无意义”。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的行动结束日期。

en.s: The 1945 Manitoba general election was held on October 15, 1945 to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. The election was a landslide majority government for the incumbent coalition government led by the Liberal-Progressive Party. The 1945 provincial election was extremely different from the previous election, which was held in 1941.

zh.s: 加拿大马尼托巴省于1945年10月15日举行大选，选出省立法议会议员。由自由进步党领导的现任联合政府以压倒性优势赢得多数席位。1945年省选与1941年上届选举的情况大不相同。

en.t: Hermann Göring dies by suicide before his execution
en.s: On October 15, 1946, convicted Nazi war criminal Hermann Göring died by taking cyanide in his cell at Nuremberg, shortly before his scheduled execution.
en.n: The Nuremberg executions took place on October 16, 1946.

zh.t: 戈林在行刑前服毒自杀
zh.s: 1946年10月15日，被判死刑的纳粹战犯赫尔曼·戈林在纽伦堡的牢房内服用氰化物自杀，时间就在预定行刑前不久。
zh.n: 纽伦堡审判的死刑于1946年10月16日执行。

en.s: Battle of Chinchow (simplified Chinese: 锦州之战; traditional Chinese: 錦州之戰; pinyin: Jǐnzhou Zhīzhàn) took place between the People's Liberation Army and the National Revolutionary Army during the Liaoshen Campaign in the Chinese Civil War. The battle was a turning point in the campaign, which eventually led to capture of Northeast China by the Communist Party.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 锦州战役是中国内战辽沈战役期间，中国人民解放军与国民革命军之间的一场战斗。此役成为辽沈战役的转折点，最终促使中国共产党夺取了中国东北。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in East Germany on 15 October 1950. They were the first held since the founding of the country on 7 October 1949. There were 466 deputies in the Volkskammer, including 66 from East Berlin who were not directly elected.

zh.s: 东德于1950年10月15日举行大选，这是该国1949年10月7日成立以来的首次大选。人民议院共有466名议员，其中66名来自东柏林，并非直接选举产生。

en.s: State elections were held in East Germany on 15 October 1950, alongside general elections to the Volkskammer. They were the last state elections in the country, as the states were dissolved in 1952. Voters were presented with a single list from the Socialist Unity Party of Germany-dominated National Front, which they could only approve or reject.

zh.s: 东德于1950年10月15日举行州选举，同时选举人民议会议员。这是该国最后一次州选举，因为各州于1952年解散。选民面对由德国统一社会党主导的国家阵线提出的单一名单，只能选择同意或反对。

en.t: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in the Border Region of Hunan–Hubei–Sichuan
en.s: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in the Border Region of the Hubei-Hunan-Sichuan (湘鄂川边剿匪) was a counter-guerrilla/counterinsurgency campaign that the Communists fought against the Kuomintang guerrilla left behind after the nationalist government withdrew from mainland China. The campaign was actually fought after the Chinese Civil War was declared over by the PRC in Beijing a year earlier, and took place in the border regions of the following three Chinese provinces: Hubei, Hunan, and Sichuan, and resulted in communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 湘鄂川边剿匪是中国共产党针对国民党政府撤离中国大陆后留下的游击队开展的反游击和反叛乱行动。中华人民共和国成立一年后，北京宣布中国内战结束，但这场行动仍在内战结束后继续进行，涉及湖北、湖南和四川三省交界地区，最终以共产党获胜告终。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列行动开始日期。

en.t: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Western Hunan
en.s: Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Western Hunan was a counter-guerrilla / counterinsurgency campaign the communists fought against the Kuomintang guerrilla left behind after the nationalist regime withdrew from mainland China. The campaign was fought during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era in western Hunan Province, and resulted in a PLA victory. This campaign was part of Campaign to Suppress Bandits in Central and Southern China.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 湘西剿匪是中国共产党对国民党政权撤离中国大陆后留下的游击队开展的反游击和反叛乱行动。行动发生于第二次世界大战后的中国内战期间，地点在湖南省西部，最终以中国人民解放军获胜告终。该行动是华中南剿匪行动的一部分。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列行动开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Heartbreak Ridge (Hangul: 단장의 능선 전투; hanja: 斷腸의 稜線 戰鬪; French: Bataille de Crèvecœur), also known as the Battle of Wendengli (Chinese: 文登里战斗; pinyin: Wéndēnglǐ Zhàndòu), was a month-long battle in the Korean War which took place between September 13 and October 15, 1951. The Battle of Heartbreak Ridge was one of several major engagements in the hills of North Korea a few miles north of the 38th parallel (the pre-war boundary between North and South Korea), near Chorwon. For the Chinese, this battle is often confused with Battle of Triangle Hill, which occurred a year later.

zh.s: 心碎岭战役又称文登里战斗，是朝鲜战争期间一场持续一个月的战役，于1951年9月13日至10月15日进行。战场位于朝鲜北部山丘，距战前南北朝鲜分界线三八线以北数英里，靠近铁原。中国方面常将这场战役与一年后发生的上甘岭战役混淆。

en.t: Construction begins on Beijing’s Soviet Exhibition Hall
en.s: On October 15, 1953, construction began on the Soviet Exhibition Hall in Beijing, now known as the Beijing Exhibition Center.
en.n: The start of construction in 1953 was separate from completion in 1954.

zh.s: 1953年10月15日，北京苏联展览馆正式开工建设，即今天的北京展览馆。
zh.n: 1953年是开工年份，工程于1954年竣工。

en.s: Hurricane Hazel was the deadliest, second-costliest, and most intense hurricane of the 1954 Atlantic hurricane season. The storm killed at least 469 people in Haiti before it struck the United States near the border between North and South Carolina as a Category 4 hurricane. After causing 95 fatalities in the US, Hazel struck Canada as an extratropical storm, which raised the death toll by 81 people, mostly in Toronto.
en.n: Hurricane Hazel devastates the eastern seaboard of North America, killing 95 and causing massive floods as far north as Toronto.

zh.s: 黑兹尔是1954年大西洋飓风季中死亡人数最多、造成损失第二大的飓风，也是该季强度最高的一场风暴。飓风在海地造成至少469人死亡，随后以四级飓风强度袭击美国北卡罗来纳州与南卡罗来纳州交界附近。它在美国造成95人死亡，之后以温带气旋形态袭击加拿大，另造成81人死亡，其中大多数在多伦多。
zh.n: 飓风黑兹尔重创北美东海岸，造成95人死亡，并引发洪灾，影响最北远至多伦多。

en.t: Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge opens to traffic
en.s: On October 15, 1957, the Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge formally opened to traffic. The road-and-rail bridge linked Hanyang and Wuchang across the Yangtze River.
en.n: The opening ceremony followed completion of construction in September.

zh.s: 1957年10月15日，武汉长江大桥正式通车。这座公路、铁路两用桥连接长江两岸的汉阳和武昌。
zh.n: 大桥于9月建成，10月15日举行通车典礼。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 15 October 1961. The Republican People's Party (CHP) emerged as the largest party, winning 173 of the 450 seats. It was the first time the CHP had won the most seats after the transition to a multi-party system, and the first time no party won a majority of seats. Voter turnout was 81%.

zh.s: 土耳其于1961年10月15日举行大选。共和人民党成为最大党，在450席中赢得173席。这是土耳其实行多党制以来，共和人民党首次赢得最多席位，也是首次没有任何政党赢得议会多数席位。投票率为81%。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Korea on 15 October 1963. They were the first elections since the 1961 May Coup, and the first during the Third Republic. The result was a narrow victory for the acting incumbent and leader of the governing military Supreme Council for National Reconstruction, Park Chung Hee, who won 46.6% of the vote, securing a transition to civilian rule under his Democratic Republican Party.

zh.s: 韩国于1963年10月15日举行总统选举，这是1961年五月政变以来的首次选举，也是第三共和国成立后的首场选举。军政府国家重建最高会议主席、时任实际领导人朴正熙以46.6%的选票险胜，随后在其民主共和党领导下实现了向文官政府的过渡。

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 1964 was won by the Labour Party with an overall majority of four seats. The election was held on 15 October 1964, just over five years after the previous election, and 13 years after the Conservative Party had retaken power.

zh.s: 1964年英国大选由工党获胜，工党取得4席的多数优势。选举于1964年10月15日举行，距上届大选刚过五年多；保守党则是在13年前重新执政。

en.t: 1964 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: On 15 October 1964, the 1964 United Kingdom general election was held in Scotland, to elect all 630 seats of the House of Commons, with 71 constituencies being in Scotland. The election was the last election fought by the Unionists as a separate party. From April 1965 the party was renamed as the Scottish Conservative and Unionist Party, and became the Scottish branch of the UK Conservative Party.

zh.s: 1964年10月15日，英国在苏格兰举行大选，改选下议院全部630席，其中71个选区位于苏格兰。这是苏格兰统一党作为独立政党参加的最后一次选举。1965年4月，该党更名为苏格兰保守党与统一党，成为英国保守党在苏格兰的分支。

en.t: 1964 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 15 October 1964, the 1964 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 630 members of the House of Commons, including the 12 Northern Ireland seats. The Ulster Unionists won all the seats in region, as they had at the previous election. In the election as a whole, the Conservative Party, which included the Ulster Unionists, led by Sir Alec Douglas-Home, lost their majority, lost power after thirteen years in government.

zh.t: 1964年英国大选在北爱尔兰举行
zh.s: 1964年10月15日，英国在北爱尔兰举行大选，改选下议院全部630席，其中包括北爱尔兰的12席。阿尔斯特统一党像上届选举一样赢得了该地区全部席位。全国范围内，亚历克·道格拉斯-休姆爵士领导的保守党失去多数席位，在执政13年后下台。该党还包括阿尔斯特统一党。

en.s: The constituency of Smethwick in the West Midlands of England gained national media coverage at the 1964 general election, when Peter Griffiths of the Conservative Party gained the seat against the national trend, amidst controversy concerning racism.

zh.t: 1964年大选中的史密斯威克选区
zh.s: 1964年英国大选期间，英格兰西米德兰兹郡的史密斯威克选区受到全国媒体关注。保守党候选人彼得·格里菲思打破全国趋势赢得该席位，竞选期间围绕种族主义问题引发争议。

en.s: The Siege of Owerri, (October 15, 1968 – April 25, 1969), was a military conflict between Nigerian and Biafran forces. The capture was a major victory for the Biafrans because the victory opened up telephone lines, enhanced road telecommunications, and showed that with stiff resistance, Biafra could defeat Nigerian forces.

zh.s: 奥韦里围城战于1968年10月15日至1969年4月25日进行，交战双方是尼日利亚军队和比亚法拉军队。比亚法拉军队攻占奥韦里是一次重大胜利，打通了电话线路，改善了公路通信，也证明只要坚决抵抗，比亚法拉就能击败尼日利亚军队。

en.s: Operation OAU (2 September – 15 October 1968) was a battle between Nigerian 3 Marine Commando Division (3MCDO) and Biafran 12 Division in modern day south-eastern Nigeria. Operation OAU was an intermittent battle that may have resulted in over 25,000 deaths on both sides. Although the Biafran soldiers were outnumbered, they were able to retain control of Umuahia and eventually recapture the cities of Owerri and Aba.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 欧盟行动于1968年9月2日至10月15日在尼日利亚东南部今境内发生，交战双方是尼日利亚第三海军突击师和比亚法拉第12师。这是一场断断续续的战斗，双方死亡人数可能超过25,000人。比亚法拉军队虽处于人数劣势，仍守住乌穆阿希亚，后来还重新夺回奥韦里和阿巴。

en.t: 1970 United Arab Republic presidential confirmation referendum
en.s: Presidential elections were held in the United Arab Republic on 15 October 1970, following the death of the incumbent Gamal Abdel Nasser on 28 September of the same year. The election took the form of a referendum on the candidacy of vice president and acting president Anwar El Sadat. According to the official results, 90% of voters voted in favor of Sadat, with a turnout of 85%.

zh.t: 1970年阿拉伯联合共和国总统确认公投

en.s: The Salvadoran Civil War was a conflict between the military-led government of El Salvador and the Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front (FMLN), a coalition or "umbrella organization" of five left-wing guerrilla groups. A coup on October 15, 1979, led to the killings of anti-coup protesters by the government as well as anti-disorder protesters by the guerrillas, and is widely seen as the tipping point toward civil war. By January 1980, the left-wing political organizations united to form the Coordinated Revolutionaries of the Masses (CRM). A few months later, the left-wing armed groups united to form the Unified Revolutionary Directorate (DRU).

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多内战是由军方主导的萨尔瓦多政府与法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线之间的冲突，后者是由五个左翼游击组织组成的联盟。1979年10月15日发生政变，政府杀害了反政变示威者，游击队则杀害了反骚乱示威者。这场政变被广泛视为内战走向爆发的转折点。1980年1月，左翼政治组织联合成立群众革命协调组织。几个月后，左翼武装团体又联合成立统一革命指挥部。

en.s: The Operation Dezful fought in early stage of the Iran-Iraq War on October 15, 1980. However, due to hassle in decision making, purge of army commander due to their participation in Nojeh coup plot, and underestimating fire power of Iraqi forces they failed to reach their goals and retreat to the eastern shores of Karkhe River in west of Dezful.

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 15 October 1985. These were the first elections since the 12 April 1980 military coup that brought Samuel Doe to power. Official results showed that Samuel Doe won the presidential election with 50.9% of the vote, just enough to avoid a runoff. His National Democratic Party of Liberia won large majorities in both houses of the Legislature. The polls were marred by allegations of widespread fraud and rigging. Many independent observers believed that the Liberian Action Party's Jackson Doe, who officially finished second, was the actual winner.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1985年10月15日举行大选，这是1980年4月12日军事政变、塞缪尔·多伊上台以来的首次选举。官方结果显示，多伊以50.9%的选票赢得总统选举，勉强避免进入第二轮。他领导的利比里亚国家民主党在议会两院均赢得多数席位。选举受到广泛舞弊和操纵的指控。许多独立观察员认为，官方排名第二的利比里亚行动党候选人杰克逊·多伊才是真正的赢家。

en.s: The 1987 Burkina Faso coup d'état was a violent military coup in Burkina Faso, which took place on 15 October 1987. The coup was organized by Captain Blaise Compaoré against incumbent far-left President Captain Thomas Sankara, his former friend, bandmate, and associate during the 1983 upheaval. Compaoré has never acknowledged that a coup had taken place and claims to be a Sankara loyalist.

en.s: The Aero Trasporti Italiani Flight 460 was a flight that crashed on 15 October 1987 in Conca di Crezzo, Italy, that took the lives of 34 passengers and 3 crew. The aircraft took off from Milan-Linate (LIN) for a flight to Cologne (CGN). Icing conditions existed. Fifteen minutes after takeoff, while climbing through FL147 in IAS hold mode (constant speed set at 133 kts) the aircraft rolled left and right.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Alberta, Canada on Monday, October 15, 2007. Since 1968, provincial legislation has required every municipality to hold triennial elections. Mayors (reeves), councillors (aldermen), and trustees were elected to office in 15 of the 16 cities, all 111 towns, all 99 villages, all 4 specialized municipalities, all 64 municipal districts, 3 of the 7 improvement districts, and the advisory councils of the 3 special areas. The City of Lloydminster is on the Saskatchewan schedule (every three years), and held elections on October 25, 2006 and October 28, 2009, while 4 improvement districts (Nos. 12, 13, 24, and 25) have no councils and are led solely by the Minister of Municipal Affairs.

en.s: Local elections were held on October 15 and 29, 2017, in the Republic of Macedonia to elect mayors and members of municipality councils of the 80 municipalities in Macedonia. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kyrgyzstan on 15 October 2017. Incumbent President Almazbek Atambayev was not allowed to run again because the constitution sets a single six-year term for the head of state. Eleven candidates registered for the race, and from this field Sooronbay Jeenbekov of the Social Democratic Party of Kyrgyzstan won more than 50% of the vote, avoiding a runoff.

zh.s: 吉尔吉斯斯坦于2017年10月15日举行总统选举。由于宪法规定国家元首只能担任一个六年任期，现任总统阿尔马兹别克·阿坦巴耶夫不能再次参选。共有11名候选人登记参选，吉尔吉斯斯坦社会民主党候选人索隆拜·热恩别科夫获得超过50%的选票，无需进入第二轮。

en.s: The 2017 Lower Saxony state election was held on 15 October 2017 to elect the 18th Landtag of Lower Saxony. The incumbent coalition government of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Greens led by Minister-President Stephan Weil was defeated. Though the SPD became the largest party in the Landtag largely fueled by the personal popularity of Weil, their gains were offset by losses for the Greens, depriving the government of its majority.

Municipal elections took place in all municipalities and regional district electoral areas in the Canadian province of British Columbia to elect mayors, school board trustees, rural directors and city councillors. en.s: The 2022 Vancouver municipal election was held on October 15, 2022, the same day as the municipal elections held throughout British Columbia. Voters elected the mayor of Vancouver by first-past-the-post. Ten city councillors, 7 park board commissioners, and 9 school board trustees were elected through plurality at-large voting. In addition, voters were presented with 3 capital plan questions. Across the city, 171,494 voters cast ballots.

en.s: The 2022 Emperor's Cup final was the final of the 2022 Emperor's Cup, the 102nd edition of the Emperor's Cup. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 15 October 2023 to elect members of the Sejm and Senate. In the previous 2019 Polish parliamentary election, the ruling right-wing Law and Justice Party (PiS) had held onto its majority in the Sejm with Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki forming a second government.
